name: Instant-Hoppers
summary: Hate that hoppers move items one by one? Well this mod makes hoppers move full stacks in one go.
description: # Instant-Hoppers ![Instant-Hoppers cover image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/instant-hoppers/main/.modcompiler-art/description-image.webp) ## What It Does - Hoppers pull items from the block they face and push them into the block they’re attached to, moving whole stacks in a single burst. - They also instantly suck up items that are dropped on top of them, so you don’t have to wait for them to pick up one by one. - Hoppers can move full stacks in one go instead of only one item at a time. - Hoppers also pull dropped items on top into themselves right away.
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio
